policy: Use the existing GenerativeAssemblyRules operations PN, inverse-PN, NE, reader-phase-advance and NN-phase-advance. Origins are natural numbers: reader/NN advance by one, other transfers have zero increment and preserve all five named references. Compare the default canonical proton seed with the complementary origin-zero seed used by chart7.
tests: Generic kernel theorem: a finite walk ending at origin zero preserves references when zero-increment steps preserve references and other steps increment origin
Fresh exhaustive zero-increment operational closure from the default seed, without a depth cutoff
Complementary origin-zero seed is valid as separately configured input but absent from that closure
Binding of actual validation rules and hostile origin/reference mutations
boundary: Kernel theorem is generic; JavaScript signature binding is checked runtime/source evidence, not a verified JS semantics. No claim about higher-origin complementary contexts, extra operations, other quotients, or the full descent conjecture.
stop_condition: Fresh kernel path theorem and exact exhausted zero-increment closure with a distinguished canonical target, or first failed signature premise.
